title: Task sync stage 1: migration, retention and atomicity integration proof
outcome: Task sync stage 1: migration, retention and atomicity integration proof
acceptance: An integration matrix covers each stage-1-admitted lifecycle row and every deferred active case, with fault injection before each final write/receipt/commit and after committed-outcome recovery, full-store conversion counts and unknown-shape refusal, connected-graph races, exact repeat versus changed intent, seal/required-child accounting, and note/activity cases

A fake host with responsibility or unknown state proves a retained candidate and zero final effects; a missing or not-found original Begin outcome is never accepted as settlement; local timers, crashes and restarts are negative controls; fake-host tests claim no production host proof
No test is skipped or weakened and no live store is converted to pass
